title: Files: collecting Daisy output and set-up files
intro: Files collects everything Daisy writes or reads: output logs (.dlf), weather files (.dwf), tables (.csv) and set-up files (.dai). Whatever is loaded here is available to the plots, the mass balance, the comparison, the calibration and the soil column.

marks.d: Reads every Daisy file of a folder, for example a whole experiment folder.
